title: hedera helix subsp. poetarum
intro: Hedera helix subsp. poetarum, commonly known as English ivy, is a subspecies of the Hedera helix plant, a flowering plant in the araliaceae family. It is known for its uses in traditional medicine, where it has been employed to treat various health issues. The health benefits of English ivy include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations, reduce stress, and boost the immune system. The plant's therapeutic actions include sedative, antispasmodic, and expectorant effects, and its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
